---
title: "Accuracy and availability"
description: "How often each OPDI item exists and how close it is to airport and Network Manager records, overall and per airport."
---

This page is being prepared. It will give, for every published item, how
often it exists (availability) and how close it is to independent records
(accuracy), overall and for the busiest airports in Europe and worldwide.

Until then, each page under [Algorithms](../algorithms/index.qmd) gives the
figures of one measured day under "Availability and accuracy", and
[Limitations](../limitations.qmd) says when each item is missing or can be
wrong.
